site.name: Connecting Ridge (Site01 ROI6)
site.coordinateRole: PGDA product 78 published ROI polygon centroid; not a surveyed touchdown point

dem.crsConvention: IAU Moon sphere R=1737400 m; south polar stereographic; x/y relative to the site grid point
dem.note: display crop only; the solver skyline uses the full 5 m tile plus LDEM 80 m to 280 km

ephemeris.azimuthConvention: clockwise from local north: N=0, E=90

gates.evidence: No comparison yet against published Site01/Site04 illumination (e.g. Barker et al. 2021, Mazarico et al. 2011).

Bound 1.76e-05 deg (~0.534 m) from NAIF generic_kernels/fk/satellites/moon_de440_220930.tf: "DE440 vs DE421 mean Earth frame difference" (max rotation 2000-2040 = 3.0709840342771E-07 rad, ~53.4 cm on the surface). Smallest |margin|: Sun 1.91121 deg, Earth 0.01528 deg; samples that could flip: Sun 0, Earth 0. Centre-event time shift <= 1.02 s, interval metrics <= 8e-05 pct-pt, hourly-sample metrics <= 0.0 pct-pt. Position effect (<= 0.53 m on the DEM) is not covered by this angle bound.

Site is the published product-78 ROI6 centroid (PGDA product 78 ROI shapefile (Barker et al. 2021), polygon-vertex centroid, fetched 2026-11-14 (fetch_extra_nasa_data.sh, SHA-256 pinned)), 332.8 m from the tile centre. Local slope at the point (5 m DEM, 50 m baseline) = 1.9 deg.

frame.note: south-polar stereographic grid at the site longitude; same basis as science/frames.py

scenarios.label: ROI point · 1 m mast
scenarios.description: site01_roi6_2026-11-14_14d_mast1m: solver outputs copied from the science bundle (sha256 00af549d34ada041…). Metrics use bisection-refined crossing intervals; strips show the hourly samples.

method.clustering: circular runs of adjacent bins whose controlling points are within 160 m (grid) plus the ray spacing D*dtheta at their mean range D
method.gap: controlling elevation minus best elevation among ray samples >= 2 DEM cells away (cell of the DEM supplying the controlling sample)
method.hours: hourly samples x 1 h; body azimuth -> nearest skyline bin; loss = centre not visible
method.ctrl_idx: index of the controlling sample along the bin ray (skyline sample array)
method.ridge_idx: index into ridges[] (null = bin in a cluster that never held the Sun or Earth in the window)
method.source: 'near_5m' = controlling height from the near-field (product 78, 5 m) DEM, 'far_80m' = LDEM 80 m
method.of_record: ridge caused at least one Sun or Earth loss sample

coverage.label: SOURCE-BASED UNVALIDATED
coverage.wording_rule: if covered_frac < 0.5, any "robust on every alternate map" claim must show covered_frac next to it

method.covered: controlling skyline sample at the body's azimuth (nearest bin) came from the near-field 5 m tile (derived.attribution.per_bin.source == 'near_5m')
method.all_hours_covered_frac: same test over all hourly samples (comparable to the batch coverage gauge)
method.uncovered_ridges: ridges (derived.attribution ids) controlling uncovered critical hours

method.clones: near field = PGDA 78 clone k, ground height from that clone, same far DEM / ray step / range as the bundle
method.ephemeris: nominal Horizons az/el reused for every clone (observer-height parallax < 1e-8 deg)
method.visible: centre visible = perpendicular margin > 0 (same test as the bundle); pct over hourly samples incl. both endpoints
method.note: clone spread = N of N terrain models tested, not a probability; clones vary only the 5 m tile

failures.note: profile in the observer tangent frame (3D, curvature included); exact-azimuth ray, so it can differ slightly from the 0.5 deg skyline interpolation; firstHit null if this ray clears the target
